_que_es: Sistemas (hud-icons, hoja C). Primero la base: node tools/render3d/icons.cjs render daily quests settings trade inventory timer lock invite teleport --out <carpeta>; después python tools/iconsheet.py compose <los 9 png en orden> --out base.png y python tools/imagegen.py generate skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/hud-c-sistemas.json --ref base.png.

ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 objects, in this order: 1) white daily calendar with a red top band, two metal rings and a yellow star on the page, 2) brown clipboard with white paper and a big green check mark, 3) silver gear with a blue jewel in the center, 4) two thick trade arrows, green pointing right on top and orange pointing left below, 5) orange backpack with a front pocket and a gold buckle, 6) red alarm clock with two bells and a white face, 7) golden padlock with a silver shackle and a dark keyhole, 8) two smiling round friend heads, blue and green, with a small green square badge showing a white plus sign, 9) round purple portal ring with small cyan gems and a pink swirl inside.
